Common questions

Where is my data stored? Only on your device. FieldCalc has no account and no server. See the privacy policy.

How do I attach a photo? Open a calculator, enter your values, and tap Photo. The picture is saved with that result in the Field log tab.

How do I delete saved results? In the Field log, tap Delete on an entry, or Clear all to remove everything, photos included.

Does it work offline? Yes. The app needs no connection at all.

FieldCalc is a convenience tool. Verify design and code calculations independently. It makes no claim of code compliance, engineering approval, or design suitability.
